system.description:
Consumes personal reserves either during use or afterward. Source: BESM4e.
Level 1: Attributes with immediate effects burn 10 Energy Points for each use (or attempted use); ongoing Attributes burn 10 Energy Point each minute of use
Level 2: Attributes with immediate effects burn 20 Energy Points for each use (or attempted use); ongoing Attributes burn 5 Energy Point each round of use
Level 3: Attributes with immediate effects burn 30 Energy Points for each use (or attempted use); ongoing Attributes burn 20 Energy Point each round of use
